channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Drone found on Black Sea coast likely Russian, officials say
item.description: A drone discovered earlier this week along Türkiye’s Black Sea coast is believed to be Russian, Defense Ministry officials said on Feb. 12, adding that the device did not contain explosives and has been transferred to police for further examination.

item.title: Over 7,000 migrants rescued in Turkish waters last year
item.description: The Turkish Coast Guard rescued more than 7,000 migrants in the country’s territorial waters in 2025 as thousands of migrants attempted to reach Europe in search of a better life, with 60 of them losing their lives in the process, media reports said on Feb. 12.

item.title: Speaker condemns brawl in parliament over Gürlek's oath
item.description: Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş on Feb. 12 condemned a brawl that broke out in the legislature after lawmakers from the ruling and opposition parties clashed over the appointment of a top prosecutor as justice minister.

item.title: Iran genuinely wants a deal with US, Fidan says
item.description: Iran “genuinely” wants to reach a real agreement with the United States over its nuclear portfolio, the Turkish top diplomat has said, stressing that expanding the scope of Tehran-Washington talks would risk compromise on nuclear issues and lead to another war.

item.title: Turkish people spend 1 hour 40 minutes daily on radio, study shows
item.description: People in Türkiye spend an average of 1 hour and 40 minutes per day listening to radio and music content, according to a new study conducted by Türkiye’s media watchdog, the Radio and Television Supreme Council (RTÜK).

item.title: UN climate chief says 'new world disorder' threatens cooperation
item.description: The U.N.'s climate chief on Thursday urged countries to unite against an "unprecedented threat" to international cooperation from pro-fossil fuel forces — issuing the appeal as US President Donald Trump rattles the global order.

item.title: Türkiye, Serbia agree to deepen defense, energy and trade cooperation
item.description: Türkiye and Serbia agreed to deepen cooperation in areas ranging from foreign policy and defense to culture and trade after President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan met Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić in Ankara, a joint declaration said.

item.title: Trump warns Iran of 'very traumatic' outcome if no nuclear deal
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump threatened Iran Thursday with "very traumatic" consequences if it fails to make a nuclear deal — but Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he was skeptical about the quality of any such agreement.

item.title: Türkiye, Syria to establish communication coordination mechanism
item.description: Türkiye and Syria plan to establish a communication coordination mechanism that will operate on a 24/7 basis and serve as a bridge between the two countries, Turkish Presidential Communications Deputy Director Ferhat Pirincci said Thursday.

item.title: Turkish warships deployed off Somalia ahead of deepwater drilling
item.description: Türkiye has dispatched a naval task force to the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters to provide logistical support and help secure upcoming offshore energy operations, as Ankara prepares to launch its first overseas deepwater drilling mission.
